O.location: January bar and dashed horizontal line
O.content: The top edge of the blue bar above the printed label "January" is horizontally aligned with the dashed horizontal line.

O.location: right end of dashed horizontal line
O.content: The dashed horizontal line has the printed label "Average" beside it.

B.text: If each month’s bar encodes its reported discharge by vertical height on the shared discharge axis, and the dashed horizontal line labeled "Average" is the monthly-average benchmark, then a month whose bar top aligns with that line is at the average benchmark and belongs in the average-band route.
B.conditions: Applies to the displayed monthly bars and assumes exact visible alignment denotes equality with the benchmark.
